summary: Iter74 end-to-end testing — admin un-RSVP + admin remove-guest endpoints + ManageRsvps dialog. Backend: 8/8 new pytest cases pass (auth, idempotency, 404s, counters integrity, member self-RSVP regression). Frontend: full UI happy-path verified (trigger visible, dialog opens, search filter narrows results, per-guest remove works, un-RSVP removes whole row with toast, event header counters refresh, browser confirm() auto-accepted). Regression: iter39 + iter50 + iter51 RSVP suites all green (41/41).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/rsvps.py is now ~950 lines and still mixes RSVP toggles, paid-event flows, ticket emails, check-in scan, admin RSVPs, bulk CSV, admin un-RSVP + admin remove-guest. Consider splitting into rsvps_self.py / rsvps_admin.py / rsvps_csv.py / checkin.py to keep each module < 400 lines.

admin_un_rsvp_member returns 200 + was_present=false for missing RSVPs (intentional idempotency), but admin_remove_guest with same missing RSVP returns 404 'No RSVP found'. Inconsistent contract — consider documenting this on the OpenAPI summary so the UI doesn't surprise admins.

AdminManageRsvpsDialog.jsx uses window.confirm() which blocks the event loop and can't be auto-accepted by Playwright unless the page.on('dialog') hook is attached BEFORE click. Works today, but switching to a shadcn AlertDialog (already in the codebase) would be a more testable + accessible pattern.

AdminManageRsvpsDialog effect re-loads on every {open, event.id} change but does not key on a parent refresh signal — if onChanged() bumps a counter in the parent, the dialog won't see it unless reopened. Fine for current flows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 testids verified, toast + counter refresh observed)
